The panel is drawn above, but it came back empty — and that's not a quirk of the query: even a bare `up` query (which any live target would answer) returns **zero rows** over the last 24 h.

So the `holotable_query_duration_seconds_count` metric — and in fact every metric in this source — has no data in the current window. Likely the demo server isn't being scraped right now or Prometheus has no recent samples. If the target comes back up, the panel's query `sum by (source) (rate(holotable_query_duration_seconds_count[5m]))` will plot executed queries per second per source as intended.
